title: Steven Greer cut the four-fingered arm from the 2000 Weygandt interview

tellings.quote: >> this was actually one of the things that Steven Greer cut out of their year 2000 interview.

plain: In a 2000 interview, a man named Jonathan Weygandt spoke of a four-fingered arm, and the UFO campaigner Steven Greer cut that part out of the version he used, according to an online researcher who goes by UAPGerb. UAPGerb tells Michels this from the raw recordings in Greer's archive, mentioning the filmmaker James Fox as well. If so, the full interview held a detail about a non-human body that Greer chose not to show.
